topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Rain's falling like it never will stop, just like this town's endless stories of people moving from one shadow to another. Took a call today, some guy at the office got transferred. Not surprising, really. Places like these, they shuffle you around like a deck of cards, one day you're sitting at a desk, next thing you know, you're staring at a whole new crew, wondering which ones'll show their true colors. Left me thinking about the last time someone got moved out. Whole room was quieter, like the echo of a lost laugh. Didn’t do much good to dwell, though. Just another mark on the doorway, another story in the making.
